resource.name: VanBobby FireRed Theme
resource.description: FireRed theme, in progress. Every window, button, tab and input is repainted in FireRed's cream-and-gold window grammar with scanlined fills, text carries FireRed's hard 1px drop shadow, and the login screen carries a painted backdrop and title plate. 0.53 puts the battle command menu where FireRed puts it, bottom right, and gives all four options the white box: the menu's position turned out to be left padding on battle-panel. 0.52 found TWL's border is (top, left, bottom, right). 0.51 gave the battle command menu FireRed's white window with black text, the pairing that fits the font set. 0.50 took the battle menu experiment back out. The battle screen keeps what works: a navy message band, and the Pokemon name merged into its HP bar as the single cream box FireRed draws. 0.47 merged the battle name and its HP bar into the single cream box FireRed draws. 0.35 put a line of air under the bag's title and padded the item squares. 0.34 moved the Pokemon's name into its box with a border rather than around it with art, and centred the Pokedex title on the band it actually sits in. 0.31 gave the Pokedex FireRed's palette, sampled off the kit at 1:1, and a gold window frame in place of the red one PokeMMO shares with fourteen other windows. 0.30 rebuilt the trainer card against the real one, with a floating header, the pale arc behind the trainer and the name in FireRed's gold. 0.29 took the bright ring off the login screen's labels, padded the Summary's held-item name, and centred the Pokedex title. 0.26 stood the bag's pocket tabs in a column down the left the way FireRed does, fixed a grid bug that left the Summary frame with no bottom or left border, and gave the trainer card FireRed's blue badges band with eight round slots.
resource.author: carlospinan
